atoms.text: Gute Texte leben von ihrem Zusammenhang. Linking words helfen dir, zusammenhängende Texte zu schreiben, die inhaltlich und sprachlich überzeugen:

example.a:
Why use linking words? First, linking words are a good way to score points in your exam. Moreover, they help you better understand your own texts; therefore, writing becomes much easier. Finally, your readers will find your texts much more appealing and convincing.
Consequently, you should master them. Although this requires some effort, it will pay off quickly.
